_comment: Tier-2 for sparta adaptive_grid: 'adapt_grid ... value f_<fixID>' before the fix has produced output reads every cell as 0. With the default 'thresh more less' SPARTA prints '  no grid adaptation performed' and no 'cells refined' line (rc=0, no warning); after a run the same command refines 395 of 400 cells. The zeros are NOT harmless: a 'coarsen' action on the same unfed fix coarsens 100 cells. Also gates the bracket rule — a single-value fix ave/grid is a per-grid VECTOR, so 'value f_ID[1]' aborts with 'Adapt fix does not calculate a per-grid array'. COVERS (added 2026-08-06): adaptive_grid:0 via unfed_fix_prints_no_adaptation_line and coarsen_on_unfed_fix_is_not_a_noop, and adaptive_grid:1 via bracketed_single_value_fix_aborts, which is the 'Adapt fix does not calculate a per-grid array (../adapt_grid.cpp:484)' bracket rule. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 prefixes the two probes that read the UNFED fix with a `run 50`, so the fix has produced output before adapt_grid reads it — the unfed-fix pathology removed and nothing else touched (same grid, same fix, same adapt_grid line, same thresholds). The refine probe then behaves exactly like the already-fed control, 395 cells refined instead of the '  no grid adaptation performed' line, and the coarsen probe prints no adaptation line at all instead of coarsening 100 cells, so the no-op moves from refine to coarsen. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES (rc=0); with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1) and these expect_in_output strings go False and disappear: unfed_fix_prints_no_adaptation_line=True, coarsen_on_unfed_fix_is_not_a_noop=True. The bracket-rule assertion is deliberately outside the hook and stays True. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/sparta/adapt_grid_unfed_fix_is_not_a_noop && python source.py (passes, rc=0), then T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py (fails, rc=1). Needs a SPARTA binary: the fixtures find spa_serial/spa_mpi on PATH or at ~/Schreibtisch/sparta/src/spa_serial, else set SPARTA_BINARY; with none present they exit 0 on a SKIP: line.
